lines.hook: What if tomorrow morning, the entire internet just... died?
lines.intro: Not your wifi. Not your phone. All of it, everywhere, for a whole week. Here's what would actually happen, day by day.
lines.relate: You know that panic when the wifi drops for like ten seconds? Yeah. Now imagine seven days.
lines.day1: Day one. You wake up, grab your phone... nothing. No messages. No maps. Your bank app? Just spinning.
lines.cash: So you go grab a coffee. Card? Declined. Cash only. And be honest, when's the last time you actually carried cash?
lines.day2: Day two. Offices just give up and send everyone home. Flights? Grounded. And this isn't made up. In 2024, one bad software update cancelled thousands of flights in a single day.
lines.day3: Day three. The shelves start emptying, and fresh food goes first.
lines.twist: But here's the crazy part. Your GPS still works, because that's satellites, not the internet. Old school radio? Works. A normal phone call? Might actually go through.
lines.day5: Day five. People do something wild. They knock on their neighbors' doors... and talk. Like, actually talk.
lines.cost: Meanwhile, every single day of this costs the world around forty-three billion dollars.
lines.real: So could this really happen? Honestly? Almost impossible. The internet is hundreds of cables under the ocean. Cut one, and the data just goes around it.
lines.day7: And day seven? It all comes back. Every. Single. Notification. At once.
lines.cta: So be honest... how long would you last? Tell me in the comments.
